requirements.text: At least 5 years of experience in infrastructure engineering, building and delivering production-grade systems.
Proven experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or systems engineering roles.
Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
Strong programming or scripting skills in languages such as Python, Java, or Golang.
Hands-on expertise with major cloud providers including AWS, Azure, or GCP and their associated machine learning services.
Apply assisted engineering approaches to reduce toil and enhance how software is built, tested, and operated.
